clips.title: 英伟达市值逼近6万亿美元 芯片板块走强
title_lines: 芯片板块走强 估值仍处多年低位

subtitles.en: On the tech front, Nvidia nearing a $6 trillion market capitalization, as investors continue buying the stock at a valuation that remains close to multi-year lows.
subtitles.zh: 科技板块方面，英伟达市值逼近6万亿美元，市场参与者持续买入，估值仍接近多年低位。
en_highlights: valuation that remains close to multi-year lows

subtitles.en: Let's bring in Bloomberg equity reporter Carmen Reineke. Carmen, I feel like that's important part about this story.
subtitles.zh: 我们请来彭博权益资产记者Carmen Reineke。Carmen，我觉得这是故事的重要部分。

subtitles.en: We are $5.8, $5.7 trillion on Nvidia and somehow it's gotten cheaper along the way.
subtitles.zh: 英伟达市值5.8、5.7万亿美元，但一路走来反而更便宜了。

subtitles.en: It really has. It's kind of crazy to look at it and even in the pre-market, it's up only a few dollars away from the $6 trillion mark.
subtitles.zh: 确实如此。看着有点不可思议，盘前也只差几美元就到6万亿了。

subtitles.en: And if you had thought about this just a few months ago, it really wouldn't have seemed like we should be anywhere near that ballpark. But you're right, as you said, Nvidia's valuation has been
subtitles.zh: 几个月前想都不敢想能接近这个水平。但你说得对，英伟达的估值一直

subtitles.en: very cheap. I think Jensen called it a growth value stock. It trades at about 17 times forward earnings. That's cheaper than the overall S&P 500. And it's very cheap compared to the
subtitles.zh: 非常便宜。Jensen称之为成长价值股。远期市盈率约17倍，比标普500整体还便宜，相比公司

subtitles.en: monumental growth that the company is still putting up. So it's interesting that we're finally starting to see investors sort of go back into this stock. And there are a few reasons for that. I mean,
subtitles.zh: 巨大的增长更是便宜。有趣的是，市场参与者终于开始重新买入。原因有几个。

subtitles.en: they had really amazing earnings, which was to be expected. I think that's what everyone sort of anticipates. They had the largest buyback ever that they announced a few weeks ago. And with high
subtitles.zh: 财报非常亮眼，这在预期之内。几周前宣布了史上最大回购。在利率高企的环境下，

subtitles.en: interest rates, companies like this look like somewhat of a safe haven. So we're finally starting to see investors sort of go back into Nvidia after a pretty choppy year.
subtitles.zh: 这类公司看起来像避风港。经历波动一年后，市场参与者终于开始重新买入英伟达。

subtitles.en: So on one hand, you could say the buybacks responsible, the stocks cheaper. On their hand, we're always talking about capacity constraints. There's not enough out there. Is this sort of the
subtitles.zh: 一方面可以说回购起了作用，权益资产更便宜。另一方面，我们总在谈产能限制，供应不足。这是不是

subtitles.en: investors saying, wait a minute, you know, you're appreciative of the buyback, but isn't there a better way to spend this money? I think it could be. I mean, it's definitely a very bullish call, right?
subtitles.zh: 市场参与者说，等等，你欣赏回购，但有没有更好的花钱方式？我认为可能有。这绝对是一个非常看涨的呼吁，对吧？

clip_research.source_claim: Nvidia is nearing a $6 trillion market capitalization, trading at about 17 times forward earnings, cheaper than the S&P 500, after its largest-ever buyback.
clip_research.public_baseline: Nvidia's market cap is around $5.8 trillion, approaching $6 trillion; forward P/E is reported around 48.3, not 17; the buyback was a record $150 billion authorization.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The claim that Nvidia trades at 17 times forward earnings is contradicted by public data showing a forward P/E of 48.3, suggesting a significant discrepancy.

winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
